name: How often does bathroom marble need to be sealed?

mainEntity.name: How often does bathroom marble need to be sealed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marble should be sealed immediately after installation and resealed every six to twelve months, depending on bathroom humidity and usage. To check if resealing is needed, drip a few drops of water onto the surface; if the water beads up, the seal remains strong. If the stone darkens or absorbs the water within a few minutes, it is time to reseal. Use only a high-grade, breathable penetrating stone sealer rather than topical coatings that can peel or trap moisture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seal marble upon installation and reseal every 6 to 12 months. If water drops absorb into the stone rather than beading on the surface, apply a fresh coat of penetrating stone sealer.
